s.title: Speed
s.description: Speed at the time of the location transaction event

lt.title: Latitude
lt.description: Latitude at the time of the location transaction event

lg.title: Longitude
lg.description: Longitude at the time of the location transaction event

d.title: Direction
d.description: Direction/Heading at the time of the location transaction event

ts.title: Timestamp
ts.description: The original timestamp in unix timestamp format at the moment location transaction event

ts_friendly.title: Friendly Timestamp
ts_friendly.description: The original timestamp in a human readable timestamp format at the moment location transaction event

alt.title: Altitude
alt.description: Altitude at the time of the location transaction event (meters)

src.title: Source Name
src.description: Source name of the location data (e.g. 'R4M' for Route4Me app)

device_time.title: Device Time
device_time.description: Local time on the device when the location was recorded

av.title: App Version
av.description: Version of the app that reported the location (e.g. 5_1_1)

dt.title: Device Type
dt.description: Device platform or type (e.g. android, ios)

abn.title: App Build Number
abn.description: App build number or route identifier associated with the tracking event

did.title: Device ID
did.description: Unique identifier of the device that reported the location
